title: TeardownRequest
description: Body of POST /api/workspace/teardown (HEL-366). `tag` selects the caller-owned data sources, pipelines, and DataTypes to delete — every resource whose stored `tag` exactly equals this value, and nothing else. `tag` is effectively required (an absent or empty value is rejected with 400 by the service layer) but is typed `Option[String]` on the wire like every other optional field in this codebase — spray-json omits `None` rather than emitting `null`, so an absent `tag` key and an explicit `tag: null` are indistinguishable and both rejected identically. `dryRun` (optional, default false — absent/null/false are all equivalent) runs the identical validation and plan computation without deleting anything; always call with `dryRun: true` first to preview scope before a real teardown.
